snippet.label: create file
snippet.desc: Create an xml-file
snippet.steps:
<!-- file to be written --> <file id="memo" x="(dir,filetemp)summer.xml" />
<!-- some variable to be written in the xml --> <prop id="name" x="<Hello Moon>" />
<!-- creating the file. Exported variables have to be surrounded with (x,....) so xml-entities are replaced. cause the file-creation itself knows nothing about xml -->
<create_file out="(file,memo)"><![CDATA[<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <memo what="is it">(x,(prop,name))</memo> ]]></create_file>
<!-- a link to the file on the terminal --> <ti label="Memo" type="file" x="(file,memo)"/>

snippet.label: loop xml, scan
snippet.desc: scan, loop-xml-xpath, PLAIN, COOP
snippet.steps:
<!-- get a directory from user --> <tk type="dir" id="what" label="Directory to scan" flag="nono" tip="Directory which files are going to be listed"/>
<!-- define file, scan that directory (only first level), print filelink -->
<file id="scan" x="(dir,filetemp)scan.xml"/>
<scan out="(file,scan)" dir="(dir,what)" level_limit="1" field="fn lm"/>
<ti type="file" x="(file,scan)" label="Scan:"/>
<!-- do the loop and print every file, sort by filename and ignore the cases --> <ti label="Loop with PLAIN xml-xpath-loop" /> <loop id="sx" xml="(file,scan)" xpath="file" sort="text" ignore_case="text"> <ti label="(loop,sx,#i)" type="file" x="(loop,sx,@fn)"/> </loop>
<!-- loop implementation with cooperation --> <ti label="Loop with COOP xml-xpath-loop" /> <loop_xml act="open" id="sy" xml="(file,scan)" xpath="file" sort="text" ignore_case="text" />
<loop id="while-1" while="()(f,loop_xml,sy,has_next?)()"> <loop_xml act="next" id="sy" /> <ti label="(f,loop_xml,sy,#i)" x="(f,loop_xml,sy,@fn)" type="file"/> </loop>
<loop_xml act="close" id="sy" />

snippet.label: xsl
snippet.desc: performs an xsl
snippet.steps:
<!-- define files --> <file id="ask" x="(dir,filetemp)ask.xml" /> <file id="xsl" x="(dir,filetemp)xsl.xsl" /> <file id="result" x="(dir,filetemp)result.xml" />
<!-- ask for system information --> <ask what="apps services vars" out="(file,ask)" style="natural"/> <ti type="file" x="(file,ask)" label="Ask:"/>
<!-- creating the xsl-file, normally you dont need this cause its already an xsl file somewhere --> <create_file out="(file,xsl)"><![CDATA[<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform"> <xsl:param name="day"/> <xsl:output method="xml"/>
<xsl:template match="/"> <xsl:apply-templates select="ws"/> </xsl:template>
<xsl:template match="ws"> <ws> <xsl:copy-of select="@*"/> <xsl:apply-templates select="apps"/> <xsl:apply-templates select="services"/> </ws> </xsl:template>
<xsl:template match="apps"> <apps> <xsl:copy-of select="@*"/> <xsl:attribute name="day"> <xsl:value-of select="$day" /> </xsl:attribute> <xsl:copy-of select="@*|node()|text()"/> </apps> </xsl:template>
<xsl:template match="services"> <services> <xsl:copy-of select="@*|node()|text()"/> </services> </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet> ]]></create_file> <ti type="file" x="(file,xsl)" label="Xsl:"/>
<!-- perform xsl --> <xslt xml="(file,ask)" xsl="(file,xsl)" out="(file,result)"> <params>day='sunday'</params> </xslt>
<!-- filelink to results --> <ti type="file" x="(file,result)" label="Result:"/>

snippet.label: Regex: Get List of Matches
snippet.desc: Get the occurences of a RegEx in a text. Get also group-values.
snippet.steps:
<ti type="file" x="(dir,status)ic-snip-regex-rs.lsx" /> <call_service job="go-joe-read"> <file id="joe-in-store" x="(dir,status)ic-snip-regex-rs.lsx"/> </call_service>
<tk label="Regular Expression: Get List of Matches" flag="(f,when,(f,exists_file,(dir,status)ic-snip-regex-rs.lsx),sum_only,sum) print"> <tk id="srl-regex" label="Regular Epression" test_first="1" flag="nono" tip="The regular expression to be applied" type="textblock"/> <tk id="srl-text" label="Text to Validate" test_first="1" flag="nono" tip="The text which should be validated against the regular expression" type="textblock"/> <tk id="srl-flags" label="Flags" type="sel" flag="multi" test_first="0" tip="Regular expression flags to use along with the regular expression"> <sel>CASE_INSENSITIVE</sel> <sel>MULTILINE</sel> <sel>DOTALL</sel> <sel>UNICODE_CASE</sel> <sel>CANON_EQ</sel> <sel>UNIX_LINES</sel> <sel>LITERAL</sel> <sel>UNICODE_CASE</sel> <sel>COMMENTS</sel> </tk> </tk>
<call_service job="go-joe-write"> <file id="joe-in-store" x="(dir,status)ic-snip-regex-rs.lsx"/> <prop id="joe-in-regex" x="srl-.*"/> </call_service> <ti_hr/> <loop id="lp" regex="(prop,srl-regex)" flag="(prop,srl-flags)"> <inline attribute="file">(prop,srl-text)</inline>
<ti label="(loop,lp,#i). (loop,lp)"/> <prop id="g" x="0"/> <loop id="w" while="()(f,lt,(prop,g),(loop,lp,#groups))()"> <prop id="g" x="(f,add,1,(prop,g))"/> <ti label="(e:o)(prop,g)(e:c)" flag="label_right">(loop,lp,(prop,g))</ti> </loop>
</loop>
